verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a well-documented official CLI (install via pipx/uv, commands like `semgrep scan` and `semgrep ci`, SARIF export, CI/pre-commit integration) that is scriptable and automatable, fitting agentic/AI-native workflows; it also ships an official MCP server, reinforcing agent-friendly tooling. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of CLI features tailored specifically for AI agents (e.g., machine-readable prompts, agent-specific flags) beyond general JSON/SARIF output.
